The F1 of 0.87 isn't from one team on one dataset in the way that sounds. The split is by whole building, never by unit or by time: nine buildings were used to learn the fault signatures and tune hyperparameters, and five buildings, 31 units and 187 episodes, were held out and used only for the final evaluation. Nothing was tuned on them. Resampling units 2,000 times gives a 95% interval of 0.83 to 0.90, and across the five held-out buildings the F1 ranged from 0.80 to 0.93. You're right that it's one estate in one climate, and we say so in the limitations. We haven't evaluated on a second estate or an external dataset, so transfer is unknown.
